defaults.composition: One natural material near the camera with a slice of highland behind

shots.subject: Snow- and frost-tipped tussock grass on an upland moor, the blades bending in the breeze and a fog-filled valley beyond

The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
